items.title: fix: reject q=0 media types in Accept.best_match()
items.body:
Description Fixes #5072 A media-range with q=0 in an Accept header means the user has explicitly ruled that type out. MediaTypeHeader.priority already parsed q=0 into a quality of 0, but Accept.best_match() never checked that value before matching, so it could return a type the user explicitly said it can't accept. accepts() which is built on best_match(), was affected the same way. Changes - Skip media types with zero quality (priority[0] == 0) when matching in best_match(). - Added test_accept_rejects_zero_quality_media_type covering best_match() and accepts().
📚 Documentation preview 📚: https://litestar-org.github.io/litestar-docs-preview/5073
